online_permitting.quote: All construction drawings must be submitted in PDF format at the time of your online building permit application Boulder County Permit Records & Online Application Submittals.

online_instant_permitting.quote: By providing instantaneous review, the SolarAPP+ reduced the average permit review time to less than one day across all five jurisdictions.

online_permitting.quote: The Department of Energy released the results of the pilot project this month in a technical report entitled SolarAPP+ Pilot Analysis: Performance and Impact of Instant, Online Solar Permitting.

virtual_inspections.quote: SolarApp+ generates a precise list of inspection items simplifying remote inspections for our inspectors and the installers.

online_permitting.quote: Apply for your permit . Log into Permit Center Account Permits: Residential Rooftop Solar: SolarAPP+ Click Apply. Include your approved set of documents and your SolarAPP approval number to proceed.

third_party_permitting.quote: SolarAPP+ is a third-party software program that can be used to verify code compliance for residential photovoltaic (PV) projects. Maricopa County Planning and Development department (PND) will accept SolarAPP+ approved designs for application and permitting of residential photovoltaic projects for unincorporated Maricopa County.
